intro.zh: 你好，我是钱美含。热衷于把机械结构设计转化为可靠、可制造的产品，熟悉冲压、压铸和注塑件设计，也重视量产中的实际问题。
intro.en: Hi, I'm Meihan Qian. I enjoy turning mechanical designs into reliable, manufacturable products. My work spans stamped, die-cast, and injection-molded parts, with close attention to real production challenges.
